theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let finite integer source sets $A,B,C$, a wanted label satisfying its exact shifted lifted-key divisibility condition, and a valid prefix at depth $k\le J$ be given. Suppose memory stores both source-stage families, a sorted permutation of all packed prefix keys, the exact pointer array, and every corresponding suffix-box table. Let query threshold and box cutoff satisfy the residual-cardinality conditions. Under the stated persistent-table, mask, Pascal, power and binary-remainder scratch reservations, lookup and value word bounds, and depth allowance, the closed catalog-query program returns the exact nonnegative raw prefix-query count within its stated time, preserving all other cells below work scratch.

Connects logarithmic catalog lookup and suffix sparse evaluation to the original reporting mass. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
